flagged.evidence: The Remark says, “A coupled temperature evolution therefore requires an additional model assumption specifying the conversion of mechanical energy into heat.” This asserts conversion is necessary for any coupling. A model on a common domain with temperature-dependent viscosity, where temperature affects the momentum equation while the thermal equation retains a source-free Fourier balance, is coupled without converting viscous dissipation into heat. The cited separate branch assumptions do not rule out such additional coupling assumptions.
